ai-wrapper-business.title: Exploring Business Opportunities for AI Wrapper Software
ai-wrapper-business.description: Case studies of AI wrapper businesses, and a strategy for what comes next.
body: Slides from a talk on AI wrapper software: products that take a user experience that already existed and automate it with AI. The 94 slides walk through vibe coding and agents, character chat, note-taking, AI diet tracking, aggregators, study helpers and more, asking which wrappers held up against Big Tech and which were swept away.
The last part picks the opportunities worth pursuing: five ideas, the moats a software business can build, and how a wrapper avoids staying just a wrapper.

ai-wrapper-business-surfers-3rd.title: The AI Wrapper Business: Surfers Cohort 3 Edition
ai-wrapper-business-surfers-3rd.description: The first, longer version of our AI wrapper talk, given to Surfers Cohort 3.
body: The first version of our AI wrapper talk, given to Surfers Cohort 3. Its 165 slides go deeper into each field: vibe coding, character chat and its three phases, note-taking, AI diet tracking, aggregators such as OpenRouter, and AI study helpers.
The deck was written in Korean and is shown here in English by default. Switch to Korean for the original.

hashchat-pitch-deck.title: HashChat Pitch Deck: A Voice Messenger Without Language Barriers
hashchat-pitch-deck.description: Why we are building HashChat, who it is for, and how a live interpreter grows into an AI-native social network.
body: Our full pitch deck. It starts from a simple problem: people want to make friends abroad, but the language gets in the way, and today's translators were never built for social conversation.
It covers early user reactions on HelloTalk, our three-stage strategy from a solo live translator to a voice messenger and then a social platform, and the target verticals in the appendix.

hashchat-pitch-deck-short.title: HashChat Pitch Deck: The Short Version
hashchat-pitch-deck-short.description: The chicken-and-egg problem of language exchange, and how live interpretation removes one side of it.
body: A shorter version of our pitch deck. Language exchange apps are stuck on a chicken-and-egg problem: you want friends abroad, and you want to learn their language. HashChat removes one side of it with live interpretation, so you can talk without a shared language.
It also covers the add-on caption and in-person interpretation demand we found, and our first goal: winning over K-Friends users.

virtually-deck.title: Virtually: VTuber Live Streaming, Powered by Generative AI
virtually-deck.description: From a single image to a live interactive broadcast.
body: The deck for Virtually, our generative AI tool for VTubers. It shows how a single character image can become a live, interactive broadcast, and where Virtually fits in the VTuber ecosystem.
The deck is also available in Japanese and Chinese from the language buttons in the bottom-left corner of the slides.

hashchat-social-network.title: HashChat: the social network without language barriers
hashchat-social-network.description: How Mingle became HashChat: a translated feed, profiles that show who you want to meet, and chats with a live interpreter built in, compared with LINE, WeChat, WhatsApp, HelloTalk, and more.
